notes.content: Continuation of a claim that a proper situation gives geometric connectedness for every linear subvariety of codimension s. Corollary 5 states surjectivity of a fundamental-group homomorphism under a corrected numbered hypothesis and the added properness assumption. Theorem 6 begins assumptions on k, X, f, L_t and D, followed by nonemptiness, smoothness/codimension/netness and boundary-divisor conditions. The final paragraph defines two tame quotients and ends at the unfinished word homomor-. These are document claims, not checked theorems.
notes.reading_coverage: Every word, accent, ending, punctuation mark and mathematical glyph in the supplied witnesses was compared with the original halves, including agreed readings. Ordinary wrapping is joined. The final page-edge fragment homomor- is retained without completion. Nineteen genuinely open places received one crop each; whole and halves were not reopened.
notes.written_reservations: No explicit authorial question or reservation is visible beyond the marginal cf. reference. Cancellation strokes were not treated as doubt marks. All uncertainty macros are this reader's record of unresolved ink.
apparent_slips: danonique has a visible d stem and is retained.
sous -espace contains a visible blank before its hyphen.
net in f est net en x is clearly readable and retained.
The preposition before X contains mixed e/s and n/u contours, left explicit rather than normalized.
The interior of codi...sion has an unresolved t-like stem in addition to crowded m/e/n contours.
notes.numbers_titles_dates: The numbered labels Corollaire 5 and Théorème 6 belong to the text. There is no separate title, authorial page number, date or stated total page count. The bottom pencil-like archive number reads 113 and is encoded as a comment. The marginal acronym/volume/exposé/item reference is not a date or page count.
notes.mathematical_considerations: The roles of the displayed variables and fundamental groups helped locate small bars, indices, arrows, the cancelled intersection, and the second quotient, but supplied no missing glyph or preferred spelling. All final candidates were retained or selected from visible contours. The differing slope in geqslant does not change the relation. No proof argument or calculation was used to resolve the ink.
notes.overprints: Reference 3/4, upper Supposons cells, crowded codi...sion, the mixed preposition, and U/V are recorded without guessing which strike was earlier. Visible cancellations separate from such composites remain explicit. The extra t-like mark over the second pi has no assigned chronology or maker.
notes.nonverbal_marks: Three marginal strokes are retained, including brown tone and darker ends where visible. Two detached points below the corrected codimension object are reproduced geometrically; no material, author, or purpose is assigned.
notes.witness_treatment: Handwritten identity wrappers alone were not counted as differences. H's inline bold heading encoding was compared only for its extent and punctuation, not for bold-versus-underline macro syntax. Each H illegibility placeholder is marked as an explicit doubt. No external H prose doubt note was supplied.
notes.limits: No OCR, recognition engine, PDF extraction, internet research, remembered external completion, other page, other reader, or additional agent was used. The supplied prior questions concerned this scan. Bounding boxes are approximate original-whole-image coordinates, not enlarged-image coordinates.
